title: Jono is a video game with 1,000,000 levels. Only one...
content: Jono is a video game with 1,000,000 levels. Only one person can play at a time, for 60 seconds, while everyone else watches on a livestream.” As of this writing, the game is up to level 179,579, and Jono has died 250,687 times.
author: Jason Kottke
